sections.heading: Type power
lines: Flash Cannon, Gear Grind, Gyro Ball, Magnet Bomb, Muddy Water, Steel Beam, and Surf also count as Electric for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Dazzling Gleam, Flash Cannon, Gear Grind, Gyro Ball, Hydro Vortex, Lumina Crash, Magnet Bomb, Muddy Water, and Surf: 1.5× stronger.
Dark Pulse, Night Daze, Night Slash, Phantom Force, Shadow Ball, Shadow Bone, Shadow Claw, Shadow Force, Shadow Punch, and Shadow Sneak: 1.3× stronger.
Light That Burns the Sky: halved (0.5×).

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Electric-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Aura Wheel, Charge Beam, Discharge, Gigavolt Havoc, Ion Deluge, Overdrive, Parabolic Charge, Tidy Up, and Wild Charge change the field into Factory once their uses add up to 2 (Aura Wheel 2, Charge Beam 2, Discharge 2, Gigavolt Havoc 2, Ion Deluge 2, Overdrive 2, Parabolic Charge 2, Tidy Up 1, and Wild Charge 2).

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Volt Absorb restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Synthetic Seed: Special Defense +1 and floats on magnetism.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
